title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
version: 2026-05-30 non-European mathematics targeted Qin Arabic side-by-side layout repair
description:
Dedicated record for non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts in the Modern LaTeX Editions project. It contains Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical works as modern-LaTeX reader PDFs, translation drafts, source files, and preservation artifacts.

Current public surface. [#######---] 58 individual work/language reader PDFs / 2959 pages. This update keeps the current work-level reader surface and promotes a targeted Arabic side-by-side layout replacement for Qin Jiushao's Shuxue Jiuzhang fascicles 1 and 4.

Status at a glance.

  • Work-level reader coverage: [#######---] broad current public surface, still working editions.
  • Source/provenance preservation: [##########] source bundles, OCR text, page images, audit notes, and broader drafts are retained in ZIP artifacts.
  • Polished critical-edition status: [----------] not yet proofread or certified.

The public organization is by work and language. The archive favors a clean reader surface while preserving provenance and repair material for continuation.
notes: Current non-European/multilingual record. Latest update promotes the targeted Arabic Qin Jiushao/Shuxue Jiuzhang side-by-side layout replacement and preserves render/compile evidence in ZIP artifacts.
